item.title: Tour de France Femmes: Niewiadoma and Vollering fight for yellow on final stage – live updates
item.summary: Live cycling updates from 15.05 BST/16.05 CET Follow us on Instagram | Mail Luke The previous two stages could hardly have been more dramatic: Kasia Niewiadoma climbed to a dominant victory on Mont Ventoux on Friday, before Demi Vollering staged a daring late attack to snatch the maillot jaune from her Polish rival yesterday. That leaves us with an enthralling, nerve-jangling conclusion to a fierce and unpredictable battle for the general classification, with the 2023 champion Vollering leading Niewiadoma by a mere eight seconds overall.
